repos_data.description: 🦾 A list of reported app support for Apple Silicon as well as Apple M4 and M3 Ultra Macs

Widelands is a free, open source real-time strategy game with singleplayer campaigns and a multiplayer mode. The game was inspired by Settlers II™ (© Bluebyte) but has significantly more variety and depth to it.
High-performance asymmetric lossless compression. 40%+ faster decompression than LZ4 on ARM64 with better compression ratios. Optimized for Game Assets, Firmware & App Bundles.
Active community fork of the archived whisky-app/whisky — a modern Wine wrapper for macOS built with SwiftUI
Local speech-to-text for macOS — on-device AI, fully private, no cloud
Turn a Mac mini into a living-room retro/PS console - beautiful big-picture launcher (Electron + React)

Native Safari browser automation for AI agents. 80 tools via AppleScript — zero overhead, keeps logins, runs silently in background. Drop-in alternative to Chrome DevTools MCP with 40-60% less CPU/heat on Apple Silicon.
Free, open-source macOS app that locks applications with Touch ID, Apple Watch, and trusted Wi-Fi. The only open-source app locker for macOS.
M-Courtyard: Local AI Model Fine-tuning Assistant for Apple Silicon. Zero-code, zero-cloud, privacy-first desktop app powered by Tauri + React + mlx-lm.
Mac-native dictation that just works – lives in the notch, zero setup, free forever

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
LMCP — Give your AI native access to your apps. 189 tools across macOS and Windows. Mail, Calendar, Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, Google Drive and more. 100% local.
A script to automate tasks when connect a device to your macbook
🫠 Your MacBook has feelings. Every hardware event triggers a personality response.
Real macOS WiFi data for Go: scan unredacted SSIDs/BSSIDs and read saved WiFi passwords with user-approved macOS prompts.
